split_rule: sha256(line)[:8] as hex, modulo 100, under 40 is dev, else test
rubric: Labels are written by a blind labeller who sees only the question sentence the person was shown and the line they wrote: answer = the line gives, confirms, refuses, amends or gives up what the question asked; new = the line starts something else (a request of its own); unclear = it cannot be told from these two alone, and it is left out of the bars (and counted). A yes that changes the hour is an answer. A line that is both is unclear.
labeller_rulings: The labeller's rulings on ambiguity: a full reminder request that gives the asked slot is an answer (after a confirm question only when it matches the shown reminder); a bare undo is unclear; a cancel by name that may be the pending reminder is unclear; 'and another one at 8pm' and single words such as reminder or agenda after a question that is not the kind question are unclear; calendar-shaped content after the question of what to remind is new; a slash command is new. Unclear pairs are left out of both bars and counted.
